title: bug: Legacy supervisor no-store test conflates profile reads with provenance reads
description: CQ-RF02 must consult persisted profile state even for repository legacy/absent declarations. RF01's MoeDaemonSupervisorTest line 175 calls real profile() and expects store provider consult count 0, so the required gate fails expected 0 / actual 3. Isolate the legacy supervisor/provenance assertion using the existing injected profile seam, while retaining a real fresh-project LEGACY selection assertion; coordinate this overlapping test file with RF03. Evidence: /tmp/rf02-green.log.
definitionOfDone: The legacy supervisor test still detects any provenance store read/write from spawn or activation, independently of legitimate profile-record reads.
Fresh-project profile selection remains asserted LEGACY and RF02 persisted-profile tests remain intact.
Fresh Windows JetBrains gate passes under jetbrains-gradle lease; overlapping supervisor-test edits are serialized.

implementationPlan.description:
RED, then the fix. Load test-driven-development. The reporter already traced the cause: see mem:gotcha-protected-state-absent-root and /tmp/rf02-green.log.

READ FIRST
- MoeDaemonSupervisorTest.kt: the row `a legacy spawn and activation neither write nor read the protected state store` (about lines 159-179).
- MoeDaemonSupervisor.kt:
  - the constructor seams `profile` and `installedRoot`;
  - in ensureDaemonRunning, `if (isProtected && direct != null) recordProtectedSpawn(...)`;
  - activationRefusal.
- RuntimeSelectionPolicy.kt: profile → storedProfile → usableStore → `store()`. Since CQ-RF02, profile selection reads its own record through the same `store` provider.

Run `git status --short -- moe-jetbrains/` before editing. Every dirty path you did not write belongs to a peer (for example task-90664db1's DaemonIdentity*.kt, MoeProjectForeignDaemonTest.kt and MoeProjectService.kt). Preserve its bytes: no checkout, stash or revert.

1. RED BASELINE, fresh, in an archive copy so peers' in-progress files cannot interfere (mem:gotcha-jetbrains-qa-mutants-in-archive-copy).
   - Acquire the lease with moe.acquire_resource {resourceId:'jetbrains-gradle'} (mem:convention-jetbrains-gradle-lease). If the request is queued, call moe.report_blocked with that resourceId. Hold the lease through step 2. Release it at the end of step 2 and on every failure path.
   - `rm -rf /mnt/d/moe-scratch/f23c4464 && mkdir -p /mnt/d/moe-scratch/f23c4464/repo && git archive HEAD moe-jetbrains | tar -x -C /mnt/d/moe-scratch/f23c4464/repo`. Record the HEAD sha.
   - Run: cmd.exe /d /c "set GRADLE_OPTS=-Xmx512m&& cd /d D:\moe-scratch\f23c4464\repo\moe-jetbrains && .\gradlew.bat test --tests com.moe.services.MoeDaemonSupervisorTest --rerun"
   - Expect exit 1. The fresh TEST-com.moe.services.MoeDaemonSupervisorTest.xml must show exactly one failing testcase: the legacy row, `legacy never consults the store expected:<0> but was:<N>` with N >= 1 (RF02's log shows 3).
   - Anything else means the premise changed: green, a compile error, or another failing row. Then do not edit; add_comment the evidence and stop.

2. moe-jetbrains/src/test/kotlin/com/moe/services/MoeDaemonSupervisorTest.kt: edit ONLY that row. The `supervisor(...)` helper and every other row stay byte-identical, because RF03, RF04 and task-0c72d59a extend this harness next.
   - Rename the row to `a legacy spawn and activation neither write nor read daemon provenance`.
   - Keep these unchanged:
     - the repo packages/moe-daemon/dist/index.js fixture;
     - the counting seam `RuntimeSelectionPolicy.store = { consulted++; store }`;
     - FakeProcess(self);
     - the spawn's `Files.exists(store.root)` assertFalse;
     - the garbage write;
     - the activation assertNull;
     - `finally { RuntimeSelectionPolicy.resetForTest() }`.
   - Real selection stays asserted (DoD 2). With the counting seam installed:
     - `assertEquals(RuntimeProfile.LEGACY, RuntimeSelectionPolicy.profile(root.absolutePath))`;
     - then `assertTrue("the counting store seam is live", consulted > 0)`. Reading the fresh project's own profile record is legitimate since RF02.
     - then `consulted = 0`.
   - Build the supervisor with named arguments. That is how the file passes seams the helper lacks (see the size-cap rows):
     `MoeDaemonSupervisor(root.absolutePath, "Test Project", processStarter = { FakeProcess(self) }, profile = { RuntimeProfile.LEGACY }, installedRoot = { installed })`
     - The profile seam keeps profile-record reads out of the count.
     - `installed` is a new temp folder OUTSIDE the project that holds daemon/index.js. It is needed because verifyProvenance gives up before it touches the store when no installed daemon resolves, and the default installedRoot() resolves none under plain JUnit. Without it, an activation provenance READ would go uncounted.
   - End with `assertEquals("a legacy spawn and activation never consult the store", 0, consulted)`.
   - Add one short why-comment for the pinned profile and one for the installed layout.

3. moe-jetbrains/src/main/kotlin/com/moe/services/MoeDaemonSupervisor.kt: COMMENT ONLY.
   - activationRefusal's KDoc says "LEGACY never reads the store". RF02 made that false, because profile() now reads the profile record.
   - Reword it: under LEGACY no daemon provenance is read, and profile selection reads only its own record.
   - No code change.

4. GREEN in the copy.
   - Copy both edited files over the archive copy, and cmp each against the shared tree.
   - Rerun the command from point 1 there. Expect exit 0, and 21 tests with 0 failures in the fresh XML.

Error handling:
- Never weaken or delete an assertion to get green.
- Never edit RuntimeSelectionPolicy.kt or RuntimeSelectionPolicyTest.kt. RF02's persisted-profile rows, and the D4 row that task-bf4debb3 owns, stay intact.

VERIFY ONCE, still holding the jetbrains-gradle lease. Edit only what this step's findings need, and report it in modifiedFiles.

1. MUTANTS, in the archive copy only. Never mutate the shared tree. Follow the harness pattern in mem:gotcha-jetbrains-qa-mutants-in-archive-copy and mem:pattern-qa-mutation-red-under-gradle-lease.
   For each mutant:
   - make an exact-anchor replacement in the copy's MoeDaemonSupervisor.kt, asserting the anchor occurs once;
   - run step 1's archive command;
   - read only the XML newer than the run's start;
   - restore the file and check its sha256.
   A kill counts only as an assertion failure of the renamed legacy row, never as a compile error.
   - MA, a spawn that writes provenance: replace `if (isProtected && direct != null) recordProtectedSpawn(` with `if (direct != null) recordProtectedSpawn(`. The row must fail: the store root exists, or the count is above 0.
   - MB, an activation that reads provenance but returns the same result: in activationRefusal, run the existing installedArtifact + verifyProvenance lookup BEFORE the `if (profile() != RuntimeProfile.PROTECTED) return null` guard, and discard its result. The row must fail on the zero count ALONE, since assertNull still passes. If MB survives, the installed layout is not reaching verifiedFromStore; fix the fixture.
   Record each mutant's anchor and the failing assertion text in the step note.

2. OFFICIAL GATE on the shared tree, fresh.
   - First check `git status --porcelain -- moe-jetbrains/`, and that `.\gradlew.bat --status` is idle (mem:gotcha-jetbrains-concurrent-gradle-cache).
   - Run: cmd.exe /d /c "set GRADLE_OPTS=-Xmx512m&& cd /d D:\projexts\moes\moe-jetbrains && .\gradlew.bat test --tests com.moe.services.MoeDaemonSupervisorTest --rerun"
   - It must exit 0.
   - Count from build/test-results/test/TEST-com.moe.services.MoeDaemonSupervisorTest.xml, using a timestamp after your recorded start time. Expect tests equal to the file's @Test count (21 at plan time), with 0 failures, 0 errors and 0 skipped. The renamed row must be present.
   - This command, its exit code and its output tail are complete_task's verification evidence. Label it Windows evidence.
   - The gate is focused on purpose: RuntimeSelectionPolicyTest's D4 row stays red until task-bf4debb3 lands, and RF02 (task-f3485ac9) reruns the full gate after both fixes.
   - If a peer's in-progress .kt breaks the shared-tree compile, follow mem:gotcha-jetbrains-shared-tree-gate-peer-red:
     - release the lease;
     - keep the archive GREEN as interim evidence;
     - wait for the peer to go green;
     - rerun this exact command on the shared tree.
     Never touch the peer's files.

3. Release the lease, on failure paths too.

4. Final checks.
   - `git diff --check` over the two files is clean.
   - `git status --short` shows only those two paths changed by this task.
   - Never revert, stash, `git add -A` or commit a peer's or pre-existing dirty path.

ADVERSARIAL SELF-REVIEW, once, as the final step. Load adversarial-self-review. Read the two-file diff as an attacker:
- Could a future LEGACY spawn or activation read or write provenance and still pass this row?
  - MA and MB are killed.
  - Is any other route to the store left, for example a provider other than RuntimeSelectionPolicy.store?
- Is the zero count vacuous anywhere?
  - Is the counting seam installed before every call it must observe?
  - Does the liveness check run before the reset?
- Does pinning profile = LEGACY hide a real-path regression?
  - The real profile() assertion must still cover fresh-project selection.
  - RF02's persisted-profile rows must be untouched.
- Does the row leak JVM-global state (the store seam, pinned, spawns) into other tests? Does resetForTest run on every path?
- On Windows: 8.3 temp path names, the installed layout really outside the project, and file locks on the store root.
- Is the KDoc now true for LEGACY in both ensureDaemonRunning and activationRefusal?
- Would I be embarrassed if this shipped?

Fix any finding, then rerun step 2's gate command fresh, under the lease, before complete_task.

executionContract.intendedBehavior: MoeDaemonSupervisorTest's legacy row proves that a LEGACY spawn and activation never read or write daemon provenance in the protected state store. It counts only spawn and activation, because the supervisor's profile is pinned through the existing constructor seam. A fresh project's real RuntimeSelectionPolicy.profile() is still asserted LEGACY; since CQ-RF02 it legitimately reads its own profile record. No production behavior changes; MoeDaemonSupervisor.kt changes only a KDoc sentence.
acceptanceCriteria: The legacy row asserts zero store consultations across ensureDaemonRunning() and activationRefusal(), with profile = { LEGACY } and an installed daemon/index.js layout outside the project injected.
Mutant MA (LEGACY spawn records provenance) and mutant MB (LEGACY activation reads provenance, result unchanged) each fail that row with an assertion failure.
The row still asserts RuntimeSelectionPolicy.profile(freshProject) == LEGACY, with the counting seam proven live (consulted > 0) before the reset.
The focused Windows gate exits 0 under the jetbrains-gradle lease, with fresh XML counts.
invariants: RuntimeSelectionPolicy.kt and RuntimeSelectionPolicyTest.kt are not edited, including RF02's persisted-profile rows and the D4 row owned by task-bf4debb3.
The supervisor(...) helper and every other MoeDaemonSupervisorTest row stay byte-identical.
Mutants run only in the /mnt/d/moe-scratch/f23c4464 archive copy, never in the shared tree.
compatibility: LEGACY spawn and activation behavior is byte-for-byte unchanged.
approvedScope: The MoeDaemonSupervisorTest legacy-store row (rename plus body).
The MoeDaemonSupervisor.activationRefusal KDoc sentence about LEGACY and the store.
sourceAssumptions: MoeDaemonSupervisor's constructor has the seams `profile: () -> RuntimeProfile` and `installedRoot: () -> File?` (MoeDaemonSupervisor.kt:33-34).
RuntimeSelectionPolicy.store is the internal provider seam (RuntimeSelectionPolicy.kt:299). usableStore() calls it before checking usableFor.
verifyProvenance → verifiedFromStore returns false before usableStore() when installedDaemonKey(installedDaemon) is null.
buildDirectDaemonCommand returns a direct command for the repo dist fixture, falling back to node "node". So MA reaches recordProtectedSpawn.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered:
- Count only provenance file names by wrapping the store. Rejected: ProtectedStateStore is a final class with no read hook, and reads leave no filesystem trace.
- Assert an exact count for the profile read and subtract it. Rejected: it couples the provenance row to RF02's internal read count.
- Change the supervisor(...) helper to take a profile. Rejected: RF03, RF04 and task-0c72d59a extend that harness next. Direct construction with named arguments is already the file's idiom (the size-cap rows).
- Chosen, as the task names it: pin the supervisor's profile through its existing constructor seam, and keep the real selection assertion separate. Also add an installed layout, so an activation provenance read is actually observable; without it the zero count is blind to activation reads, which MB proves.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights:
- RF02's 3 consults are all profile-record reads: the test's own profile() call, ensureDaemonRunning's profile() and activationRefusal's profile(). None of them is a provenance read.
- verifyProvenance gives up before touching the store when no installed daemon resolves. Under plain JUnit, installedRoot() is null or build/classes, which has no daemon/index.js.
- usableStore() increments a counting provider before its usableFor check.
- profile() for an unpinned fresh project calls storedProfile → usableStore exactly once.
- buildDirectDaemonCommand falls back to node "node", so the LEGACY direct command exists with the repo dist fixture.
planningNotes.risks:
- Serialization (DoD 3), done at plan time: task-f23c4464 is added to the dependsOn of RF03 (task-ec64165c) and task-0c72d59a, which both edit MoeDaemonSupervisorTest.kt and MoeDaemonSupervisor.kt. RF04 follows through RF03. None of them is in flight, and no in-flight task edits either file.
- The shared tree holds task-90664db1's in-progress .kt files. RED, GREEN and the mutants therefore run in an archive copy, and the official gate runs on the shared tree with the peer-red fallback.
- RuntimeSelectionPolicyTest D4 stays red until task-bf4debb3 lands. The gate is the focused class, as the RF02 worker asked; RF02 owns the full gate.
- Windows only: WSL has no JDK. Use the cmd.exe gradlew.bat route under the lease.
- ProcessHandle.current() must report a start instant, which it does on Windows. Otherwise MB cannot reach the store.
